ayahOccurrences.text: وَقَالُوٓا۟ آمَنَّا بِهِۦ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلتَّنَاوُشُ مِن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَقَالُوٓا۟ آمَنَّا بِهِۦ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلتَّنَاوُشُ مِن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: ٱلتَّنَاوُشُ is in the derivative form: تَنَاوُشٌ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ن/و/ش   n–w–sh skirmish; to seize; to hang on to, to receive; to save; to come face‐to‐face with. Of this root, تَنَاوُشٌ tanāwush, occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
تَنَاوُشٌ tanāwush [v. n.] the act of attaining, reaching grasping, comprehending, embracing

(34:52) وَقَالُوا ءَامَنَّا بِهِ وَأَنَّى لَهُمُ التَّنَاوُشُ مِنْ مَكَانٍ بَعِيدٍ they will say, ‘Now we believe in it [the truth],’ but how can they attain [to faith] from such a distant place?
